0.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_GOODLOOKINGMEMBER_000_000
0.description: What an entrance! It was as if it appeared out of thin air! Now, can someone tell me exactly what in the world <hex:021A020203>it<hex:021A020103> is?

1.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_GOODLOOKINGMEMBER_000_010
1.description: A <hex:021A020203>moogle<hex:021A020103>? Well, they bear no resemblance to the moogles in our productions. Our poor costumiers will have to start from scratch.

2.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_GOODLOOKINGMEMBER_000_020
2.description: Oh, wonderful! A trip to the southern seas! Not that I will be disembarking, mind you.

3.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_GOODLOOKINGMEMBER_000_040
3.description: Finally leaving, are we? Well, this should be exciting! Though not for those lizards, perhaps...especially if it turns out their captain has gone the way of that other fellow.

5.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_GARLEANSMEMBER_000_010
5.description: It took me five summers and ten auditions to earn my place on the <hex:021A020203>Prima Vista<hex:021A020103>. That <hex:021A020203>thing<hex:021A020103> is in for a surprise if it believes the principal will grant it a role on <hex:021A020203>our<hex:021A020103> stage.

6.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_GARLEANSMEMBER_000_020
6.description: I will admit, since arriving here in the south, there has not been a dull moment. Not that life back in Garlemald is dull, by any means. Only that you foreigners seem to embrace chaos where the sane man would seek to prevent it.

7.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_PRETTYMEMBER_000_000
7.description: Well is that not the sweetest thing you've ever seen! You <hex:021A020203>can<hex:021A020103> see him, can't you? It's not just me?

8.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_PRETTYMEMBER_000_010
8.description: These moogle creatures are utterly adorable! Do you think he'd mind if I stroked him?

9.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_PRETTYMEMBER_000_020
9.description: Given what the Empire did to the Bangaa's homeland...and the fact that we hail from <hex:021A020203>you-know-where<hex:021A020103>...do you think we should be worried?

10.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_PRETTYMEMBER_000_040
10.description: Yes, the Bangaa attacked you, stole the principal's precious heirloom, and held a knife to the throat of his daughter...but I don't see any reason why we shouldn't forgive them, do you?

11.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_000
11.description: How much fur do you think that creature's hide would yield? Just...hypothetically.

12.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_010
12.description: I had always wondered what moogles truly looked like. Something about the costumes we use here always seemed a little...odd.

13.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_011
13.description: The rabbit-like ears, the long limbs, the wispy singlets─

14.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_012
14.description: If I did not know better, I would think our costumier had absolutely no idea what a moogle was...

15.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_000_020
15.description: Experience has taught me that one ignores one's intuition at one's own peril. And something most definitely does not feel right about all of this.

19.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_MUSCULARMEMBER_000_000
19.description: What does a fur-clad potbelly have on a bronzed chest of rippling thew? I shall tell you─absolutely nothing!

20.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_MUSCULARMEMBER_000_010
20.description: Moogles, you say? Pah, I play a moogle in <hex:021A020203>The Zodiac Brave Story<hex:021A020103>, and I can tell you, <hex:021A020203>true<hex:021A020103> moogles are little like those portly vermin hovering before us.

21.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_MUSCULARMEMBER_000_020
21.description: While I do not condone the brutish tactics employed by our trio of unwanted guests, I feel it would be remiss of me not to commend them on their immaculate musculature.

22.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_MUSCULARMEMBER_000_040
22.description: Their ways may be barbaric, but their hearts seem true enough...as do their upper arms, their thighs, and their abdomens. Gods...those abdomens!

23.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_PERFORMANCEMEMBER_000_000
23.description: Is that one of your faeries? No...it couldn't be. We're not over Eorzea. A kami, then! I had no idea they were so...rotund.

24.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_PERFORMANCEMEMBER_000_010
24.description: Hm? A “moogle”? Never heard of them. Are you quite certain it's not a kami? Or a yokai, perhaps?

25.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_PERFORMANCEMEMBER_000_020
25.description: What I wouldn't give to hear the Bangaa sing some of their kingdom's traditional songs...but mayhap now is not the time.

26.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_PERFORMANCEMEMBER_000_040
26.description: When all of this is over, I am going to ask the principal for leave to visit the Dalmascan mainland. If Dalmasca's ties to Ivalice are as strong as he claims, there may be much to gain from studying the kingdom's musical tradition.

27.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_DANCINGMEMBER_000_000
27.description: Wait, don't tell me! That's a─ It's aaa... A maggle! Yes, Eorzeans breed them for their meat! I read all about it in <hex:021A020203>Eat, Prey, Die<hex:021A020103>─the Culinarians' Guild publication, you know? They're meant to be delicious!

28.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_DANCINGMEMBER_000_010
28.description: Not a maggle, you say, but a moogle? <hex:021A020203>Eat, Prey, Die<hex:021A020103> says nothing of moogles. Are they as delicious as maggles?

29.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_DANCINGMEMBER_000_020
29.description: One, two, three... One, two, three...<hex:02100103>Naught like a well-choreographed routine to see you through testing times.

30.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_DANCINGMEMBER_000_030
30.description: One, two, three... One, two, three...<hex:02100103>Do you think the Bangaa have dances of their own? And do you think they would show me? No? You're probably right...

31.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_ASSISRANTDIRECTOR_000_000
31.description: Before Cid left, he handed me this queer contraption. Said it was an Allagan storage node, and that if I activated it, I'd hear the principal's voice as if he were standing right beside me. Would you care to try it?

32.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_ASSISRANTDIRECTOR_000_001
32.description: <gulp> An Allagan! They've woken from their slumber to punish us for the wanton misuse of their relics!

33.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_ASSISRANTDIRECTOR_000_010
33.description: Before Cid left, he handed me this queer contraption. Said it was an Allagan storage node, and that if I activated it, I'd hear the principal's voice as if he were standing right beside me. Would you care to try it?

34.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_ASSISRANTDIRECTOR_000_070
34.description: Before Cid left, he handed me this queer contraption. Said it was an Allagan storage node, and that if I activated it, I'd hear the principal's voice as if he were standing right beside me. Would you care to─ Wait, shouldn't you be at the lighthouse?

35.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_ASSISRANTDIRECTOR_000_080
35.description: Before Cid left, he handed me this queer contraption. Said it was an Allagan storage node, and that if I activated it, I'd hear the principal's voice as if he were standing right beside me. Would you care to try it?

36.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_ASSISRANTDIRECTOR_000_090
36.description: Before Cid left, he handed me this queer contraption. Said it was an Allagan storage node, and that if I activated it, I'd hear the principal's voice as if he were standing right beside me. Would you care to try it?

37.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_ASSISRANTDIRECTOR_000_091
37.description: Perhaps if Cid ever returns we can get him to record your voice. That's assuming <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> return, of course.

38.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_ASSISRANTDIRECTOR_000_100
38.description: Before Cid left, he handed me this queer contraption. Said it was an Allagan storage node, and that if I activated it, I'd hear the principal's voice as if he were standing right beside me.

39.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_ASSISRANTDIRECTOR_000_101
39.description: I've been trying to convince him we could use a device like this in one of our productions, but Master Jenomis is having none of it. Says it can't be trusted. Would <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> care to try it?

41.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_WANDERINGWRITER_000_010
41.description: Desert moogles, now? I suppose that would explain their current state of dishevelment.

42.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_WANDERINGWRITER_000_020
42.description: My fellow thespians are wont to claim that the Ridorana Cataract is a one-way gate to the seventh hell. While I am not about to take their word for it, neither am I inclined to put their theory to the proof.

45.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_WANDERINGWRITER_000_080
45.description: These auracite relics are fascinating, are they not? If only we knew how to harness their power...without being possessed, I mean.

46.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_WANDERINGWRITER_000_090
46.description: Another bout with a soulless denizen of the deep? No rest for the righteous, eh?

47.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_WANDERINGWRITER_000_091
47.description: If things take a turn for the worse, do not hesitate to flee. There is no shame in yielding the battle if it eventually wins you the war.

48.name: TEXT_REGHINCOMPANYMENMBERS43_00483_WANDERINGWRITER_000_040
48.description: They say a rose is a rose is a rose. So tell me, adventurer, is that a rose in your pocket, or are you simply here for small talk?
